scope: Fresh S4 Android screen/takeover control-path delay; no code, UI input, or write RPC performed by this audit

readonly_screen_probe.result: new screen WS immediately reported driver=user and one tab

server.server_state_conclusion: takeover state was applied and persisted; no evidence of a server-side manager split or missing screen-state transition

android.eventual_observation: around 01:36 Asia/Shanghai, native UI changed to user-control/Bot paused, input field appeared; root then submitted s5-android-input and observed the received marker, followed by native handback preparation

client_path_evidence.deterministic_behavior: ComputerScreen keeps its local takeover flag false until repository.call(takeover.start) returns. statusLabel(false, driver=user) therefore still selects the Bot-working label, even when the server screen state is already user.
client_path_evidence.supporting_log_observation: adb logcat for the Android process showed repeated MainConnection xr reconnects/sync_done delay and severe rendering stalls during the mismatch window
client_path_evidence.exact_delay_stage: undetermined: available evidence does not distinguish control-WS waiter/reconnect replay from repository mutex/snapshot persistence after the RPC response; no request-level client timestamps were recorded

acceptance.eventual_native_handback: being completed by root in the same live session
acceptance.boundary: This audit records the delayed but eventual control-path convergence. It does not claim the concrete delay stage or full S4/S5 pass.

next_safe_diagnostic: If needed after the live acceptance, add timestamp-only instrumentation around ComputerScreen repository.call, MainConnection request completion, and ClientRepository persist; do not log passwords, message bodies, or screen contents.
